ACCEPT — PR #13283 @ `7fee29f8d5a3ec2cf4909081f038b8e88eb191b8` · `domain:ui` seat 2 (`session_01XVp19E1MYUTFM3dnkwz8gB`)

- Clause-②: no. An internal index and an internal helper move; `appReportIndex.ts` is not re-exported. No contract review is owed, and the seat read the report.
- Seat review: `appShippedReports` lists the union of the reports the app's package owns and every report a `type: 'report'` entry of the served navigation names, at any depth, including module contributions through `navigationContributions`. Each name is listed once (the owned document first, else the first served). A navigation entry naming an unserved report is skipped. The dataset read gate is unchanged and applies to the union. The walk is the palette's `flattenNavigation`, moved into `appReportIndex.ts` and imported back by `CommandPalette.tsx` (ruling 1: one walk, not two). The docblock says what the index lists.
- Pins: (a) owned A and B plus contributed C are all listed; (b) the read gate hides an unreadable report, contributed ones included; (c) an unserved navigation report is skipped; (d) CONTROL: a single-package app lists its own reports. The ablation (the navigation union dropped) turned (a)–(c) red with (d) green, and the restore was proven by blob. The palette family, the index tests and the source-reading tests are green.
- Changeset: `@object-ui/app-shell` `patch`.
- CI: all 36 check-runs completed on the head, 33 passed and 3 skipped.
- Path fork: no governed path. Seat landing.
- Findings: Acceptance notes. (1) `SearchResultsPage.tsx` keeps its own private copy of the same walk, a third spelling. (2) The index does not apply navigation `visible` expressions to the reports the navigation names, and never did for owned reports. Neither is filed.

Next: ready + auto-merge; landing is verified by content on `main`.
